issue_text.not_visible: Step back so your whole body is in frame
issue_text.chest_up: Keep your chest up, you're leaning too far forward
issue_text.knees_past_toes: Sit back into your hips, knees are drifting past your toes
issue_text.hips_sag: Brace your core, your hips are sagging
issue_text.hips_pike: Lower your hips into a straight line
issue_text.not_plank: Get into a plank position, side-on to the camera
issue_text.elbow_drift: Keep your elbow pinned to your side
issue_text.swinging: Don't swing your torso, keep it still
issue_text.arms_down: Start with your hands at shoulder height
issue_text.not_deep_enough: Go through the full range of motion
issue_text.too_fast: Slow down and control the movement
